name: Sanofi Consumer Healthcare India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2023, Sanofi Consumer Healthcare India Ltd manufactures and trading of drugs & pharmaceutical products.[1]It is a division of Sanofi, a global pharmaceutical company, focusing on over-the-counter (OTC) and consumer healthcare products. [2]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
SCHIL was formed following its demerger from Sanofi India Limited, to establish a standalone Consumer Healthcare (CHC) business. It operates in the Consumer Healthcare (CHC) sector, providing self-care solutions across various health categories including allergy relief, pain management, and wellness

cons: Stock is trading at 42.9 times its book value
